title: CFB Top Picks Research + Completeness V2 — Step 5 defense + pace research
project: CFB Top Picks Research + Completeness V2
problem: Top Picks had verified offensive scoring research but still lacked opponent defensive allowance and tempo/pace evidence behind the matchup.
root_cause: The selected-game detail payload did not route existing certified ESPN/NCAA defense and pace fields into a read-only Top Picks research layer.
patch: Add a descriptive field router for points allowed, recent allowance, yards/play allowed, pass/rush allowance, red-zone defense, explosive-efficiency susceptibility, plays/game, seconds/play and same-division pace index. Render it only after a matchup is tapped.

control_plane_repair.retry_terminal: cancelled externally during browser proof; pure contract 10/10 green
control_plane_repair.root_cause: Streamlit option portal may transiently expose only the selected market while rerun hydration is still completing.
control_plane_repair.patch: Wait up to 20 seconds for the requested existing option to appear before issuing a terminal missing-option assertion.

responsive_market_portal_repair.exact_failure: CFB_TOP_PICKS_NAV_STEP3_PUBLIC_OPTIONS_NOT_VISIBLE during final responsive width after 390 and 768 were already green
responsive_market_portal_repair.evidence: Rendered body still contained Top Picks V5 marker, Step-5 marker, all 10 ranked cards, and correct CFB content.
responsive_market_portal_repair.root_cause: After viewport resize, Streamlit rerendered the visible combobox before its option portal finished hydrating.
responsive_market_portal_repair.patch: Retry the market open/read cycle for up to 30 seconds and require the full frozen four-market set before certifying.
